_about: Public-domain Georg Benedikt Winer (1789-1858), Leipzig Lutheran biblical scholar, for the Word Hoard: A Comparative View of the Doctrines and Confessions of the Various Communities of Christendom (Clark, 1873), A Grammar of the Idiom of the New Testament (Thayer's revision, Andover 1869), A Treatise on the Grammar of New Testament Greek (Moulton's translation, Clark 1870) and the Grammar of the Chaldee Language (Andover 1845), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 48 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

winer-comparative-view: A comparative view of the doctrines and confessions of the various communities of Christendom, with illustrations from their original standards (Edinburgh, Clark, 1873)
winer-grammar-thayer-1869: A grammar of the idiom of the New Testament (Andover, W. F. Draper; Philadelphia, Smith, English, & co.; [etc., etc.], 1869)
winer-grammar-moulton-1870: A Treatise on the Grammar of New Testament Greek, regarded as the basis of New Testament exegesis (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1870)
winer-chaldee-grammar: Grammar of the Chaldee language :  as contained in the Bible and the Targums (Andover : Allen, Morrill and Wardwell, 1845)

_alternates.winer-copies: Earlier English versions of the NT grammar (Stuart and Robinson 1825, Agnew and Ebbeke 1840, Masson 1859-1861) and later printings
